fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) stock is down 30% from its late-spring peak, primarily due to negative free cash flow in the last two quarters and management's forecast of accelerating cash burn.
fields.summary_ko.1: Alphabet plans $195–205 billion in capital expenditures this year, with cash burn expected to peak around $80 billion in 2027, but analysis suggests it will turn positive from 2029 onward.
